title: API Validation Testing
description: Build an API validation testing suite that validates email format, handles missing fields, and returns appropriate error responses.

steps.title: Validate email format
steps.description: Create a POST /validate endpoint that accepts an email field and returns 200 if valid, 400 if invalid.
hints: Accept JSON body with an email field
Check if email contains @ and a domain with a dot
Return 400 with error message if invalid, 200 with success if valid

steps.title: Missing field validation
steps.description: Test that POST /validate with a missing email field returns 400.
hints: Send a request without the email field
Ensure the server returns 400 Bad Request
Check that the error response includes a descriptive message

steps.title: Correct data validation
steps.description: Test POST /validate with correct email data to confirm 200 response.
hints: Send a valid email like test@example.com
Expect 200 with valid: true in the response
Make sure previous error handling still works
